Getting started on Reelo.

Add your screens.

Upload up to 12 images and set your canvas size using an uploaded screen or custom dimensions. Images retain their proportions and transparency. Drag to reorder them.

Make it yours.

Adjust the duration and transition style to set your pace. Personalize your background, padding, and corner radius to frame your work. Transparent backgrounds are supported for PNG and GIF only.

Export your showreel.

Save the current frame as a PNG, a 30 fps video, or a full-resolution, looping GIF at 20 fps. Everything happens locally in your browser. Your files stay yours.

Creating your reel...

Keep this tab open while your video renders.
